scientific_integrity: The stationary Gaussian-mixture transform, scalar marginal cutoff, general class-L polar criterion, subordination inheritance, and Bessel identity are prior inputs; the new result is the sharp vector class-L threshold, constructive vector Lévy bath, and strict projection-versus-joint interval. No independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to equal-rate two-state common switching, spatially isotropic harmonic confinement in finite integer dimension d>=2; scalar-drift Lévy-OU stationary marginals, not general drift or full temporal processes. All-dimensional proof is analytic; numerical checks finite; publication priority awaits independent verification.
title: A dimension gap in Lévy–Ornstein–Uhlenbeck realization of an intermittently trapped Brownian particle
